{{Quote|I believe they are ''Ru'', an indigenous species usually to be found scavenging for scraps around Phorosian marketplaces. The locals speak of them as vermin.|[[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Paradise Lost" />}}
The '''Ru''' were a small, [[Hair/Legends|furry]], and primitive [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phorose]]. Despite the fact that the [[Phorosian|locals]] considered them [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]], [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] believed that the Ru were, in fact, sentient beings, due to the fact that they worshiped in temples that they built.

During the [[Battle of Phorose|battle]] of Phorose around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] accidentally found a group of Ru that had been living in a temple under the Phorosian [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Their temple was destroyed by a patrol of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] sent to eliminate the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and while the survivors were being evacuated via a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]], the gunship was attacked by two [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], killing the Ru onboard, except for two survivors.
